prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. A finished square children's coloring-book page for finger coloring on an iPad mini. Beautiful professional hand-drawn illustration, recognizable coherent anatomy and an appealing expressive face. SIMPLE bold near-black continuous outlines on pure white. Large uninterrupted enclosed white coloring spaces. Main subject fills about two-thirds of the page with ample white margins. Background is almost empty: only the specifically requested background objects. Aim for 15–35 main coloring shapes, with very few small incidental areas. Broad smooth silhouettes, minimal interior contour marks. Line thickness approximately 5–7 pixels at 1024px, all important outlines equally readable. No fine lines, texture, shading, hatching, fur strokes, hair strands, grass blades, leaf veins, brickwork, glitter, tiny ornaments, rivets, repeated patterns, patterned clothes or intricate decoration. No color or gray. Tiny pupils may be black. No text, logos, frames, speech bubbles or panels. Do not add extra scenery or props. White spaces should be easy to tap, not narrow slivers. Characterful and polished, not geometric clipart.
Subject: Two original preteen friends with distinct simple hairstyles, standing together proudly beside their large simple hand-made club banner, which is a plain empty rectangle they can decorate themselves. One friend holds each side of the banner. Warm expressive faces, natural preteen proportions and clear friendly body language. Plain short-sleeved shirts, plain trousers, broad simple shoes. White background with no furniture or room details. No text, intricate fingers, decorative hair marks, patterned clothes or tiny props.
Style: Original young-reader graphic-novel interior illustration adapted for a coloring book. Character-driven visual storytelling, clear body language, nuanced friendly expressions, natural slightly stylized human or feline proportions, expressive clean hand-inked contour drawing. Preteens look their age, not babies or chibi superheroes. Avoid oversized sparkly eyes, capes, action-comic costumes and mascot faces. Hair drawn in broad solid white masses with only two or three contour divisions. All clothes and backgrounds plain. One single story scene with no panels or speech bubbles. Do not imitate any specific artist or reuse named characters.
Critical simplification: only TWO people. Very bold smooth strokes for every contour, including faces and hair. Approximately 7px black outlines at 1024px throughout, not thin pen drawing. Draw each hairstyle as one or two large closed masses with NO interior strands. Eyes and smiles are simple broad shapes. Target fewer than 50 separate closed regions; fewer than 15 small incidental details. Preserve original young-reader graphic-novel storytelling with school-age characters; no chibi or giant eyes.
